title: Migrate Recommended Apps & Connectivity Apps to Official Marketplace Catalog API
summary: Recommended Apps and Connectivity Apps now get app logos from the official Marketplace Catalog API instead of the undocumented AppSource endpoint, which Azure WAF now blocks. The API key comes from Azure Key Vault and must be provisioned in the environment.
key_points: Migrated from blocked undocumented endpoint to official catalogapi.azure.com API
Integrated Azure Key Vault for secure API key management using SecretText
Updated JSON response parsing to read largeIconUri from top-level response
Removed User-Agent spoofing no longer needed with official API
Updated test assertions for new API error response format
